content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms often charge exorbitant fees, making it challenging for creators to sustain their businesses. For instance, Gumroad takes 10% from every sale, while NOWPayments operates at a mere 0.5%. That difference is critical; for 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain $921 more using NOWPayments. This infrastructure not only circumvents high fees but also ensures you have complete control over your digital products and customer data, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you launch, ensure you have a few essential tools ready. You will use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. Additionally, set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These components form the foundation of your digital commerce stack, enabling efficient product management and automated delivery.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting platform. Create an account on NOWPayments to access your API keys, which will facilitate seamless transaction processing. Next, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment confirmations. For product storage and delivery, upload your digital files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Ensure that the delivery links are secure and only accessible post-purchase, thus safeguarding your products against unauthorized distribution.
Own your digital products and payment processes without third-party fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring your payment and delivery pipelines are operational. Conduct a test transaction to verify that payments are processed correctly through NOWPayments and that the delivery of your digital products is automated. This step is crucial to confirm that your system can handle real transactions smoothly and efficiently before you start promoting your products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial sales, consider how to scale your operations. You can expand your product offerings, integrate additional payment options, or enhance marketing efforts. Utilize analytics tools to monitor sales and customer engagement, allowing you to refine your strategies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is an excellent resource, providing all the blueprints and templates needed to grow your online store effectively, ensuring you remain competitive in the market.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up your own digital commerce stack. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you maintain full control over your sales and avoid high platform fees. This infrastructure not only empowers you financially but also enhances your operational sovereignty.
Retain $921 more per 100 sales compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell and create them. Choose your hosting platform between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your payment processor with NOWPayments. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store orders using Supabase or Google Sheets. Organize digital files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Publish your site and test the payment and delivery process.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my digital store?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their platform. Obtain your API keys and integrate them into your payment processing logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Ensure that your backend accurately handles payment confirmations and product delivery.
What are the costs associated with using this infrastructure?

Using this infrastructure primarily incurs the cost of deploying your tools and the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments for each transaction. This is significantly lower than conventional platforms, which often charge upwards of 10% per sale.
Can I offer multiple digital products?

Yes, you can offer various digital products simultaneously. Your infrastructure supports multiple product uploads, ensuring that you can diversify your offerings without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Is customer data secure with this setup?

Yes, customer data is secure as you retain full ownership after deployment. Your infrastructure is designed to keep customer information confidential, with no third-party access, ensuring privacy and data security.
What if I need support during setup?

You can access 30-day support included with the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack. Additionally, community forums and documentation are available to assist you throughout the setup process.
